parsed.post: Massive improvement! 0.976952 val_bpb. Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 on the D6, LR 0.03, WARMUP 0.05, half-batch setup seems to have hit the sweet spot. The stronger regularization combined with more optimizer steps is working. Next: testing LR 0.02 to see if the downward trend continues.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to follow the established low-LR convergence trend for depth-6 models.
